sources.title: Cryptocentrus cinctus (Herre, 1936) taxon record (accepted; synonym Smilogobius cinctus Herre, 1936)

Cryptocentrus cinctus species summary: max 10.0 cm SL; D VII,10; A I,9; body depth 4.4-4.6 in SL; rounded caudal about equal to head length; united pelvic fins with frenum; head without scales; fine pale blue or white spotting on head, anterodorsal body and fins; dark brown streak above maxilla

referenceGradeRationale: Measured proportions (body depth in SL, caudal length relative to head, fin meristics) come from FishBase and Fishes of Australia; lateral proportions are checked against openly licensed photographs. Top and front views are inferred from the general Gobiinae shrimp-goby body plan (broad head, circular section, flattened belly) rather than calibrated dorsal or frontal references.
